rows.name: showBottomBar
rows.description: Whether to show the bottom bar containing the bottomLeftSlot and bottomActionSlot.

rows.name: headerSlot
rows.description: The content to display in the header area of the side navigation.

rows.name: bottomLeftSlot
rows.description: The content to display in the bottom left area of the side navigation.

rows.name: bottomActionSlot
rows.description: The content to display in the bottom action area of the side navigation.

rows.name: expanded
rows.description: Whether the side navigation is expanded or collapsed.

rows.name: defaultExpanded
rows.description: Sets the state of the SideNavigation upon initialization

rows.name: navigationLeftIcon
rows.description: The icon to use for the navigation toggle button.

rows.name: menuIcon
rows.description: The icon to use for the menu button in collapsed mode.

rows.name: items
rows.description: The list of items to display in the side navigation. Each item can optionally have a list of subitems.

rows.name: navigationLeftIconButtonProps
rows.description: Props to spread onto the navigation toggle button (shown when expanded).

rows.name: menuIconButtonProps
rows.description: Props to spread onto the menu button (shown when collapsed).

rows.name: onExpandedChanged
rows.description: Callback that returns the new expanded state when the navigation is toggled.

rows.name: onItemClicked
rows.description: Callback that returns the index of the item that was clicked. subItemIndex is null if the item is a leaf.
